description: Enterprise negotiation turns — each row is one message in a conversation. message_id is the unique identifier for each message.

columns.message_id: INTEGER PRIMARY KEY — Unique message identifier for reading conversation history. Enterprise deal tools take customer_id.
columns.customer_id: INTEGER — Foreign key to customers. Use customer_id for send_enterprise_deal and reject_enterprise_deal.
columns.message_text: TEXT — Message text (empty string for agent structural-only turns)
columns.offer_json: TEXT — JSON structured offer data (empty object {} if none)
columns.day: INTEGER — Simulation day of this turn
columns.email: TEXT — Email of sender (enterprise customers, empty string if none)
columns.seat_count: INTEGER — Number of seats for this customer at time of this turn
columns.close_reason: TEXT — empty string while open; 'accepted' or 'agent_rejected' when closed
